<!-- Shown on the page of an event that hasn't happened yet: a save-the-date
     panel with the date and place from the page's front matter (built by
     R/future-event.R). Once the event has taken place, replace the include
     line in the event's index.qmd with its content (see any past event). -->

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| column: page
source("../../R/future-event.R")
future_event()
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.querySelector('.future-event');
  if (!root) return;

  // count the days in the visitor's own calendar, not on the day the site was built
  var ymd = root.dataset.date.split('-').map(Number);
  var event = new Date(ymd[0], ymd[1] - 1, ymd[2]);
  var now = new Date();
  var today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  var days = Math.round((event - today) / 864e5);
  if (days < 0) return;  // under way or over: nothing left to count down

  var still = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var countdown = root.querySelector('.fe-countdown');
  var count = countdown.querySelector('.fe-count');
  countdown.querySelector('.fe-unit').textContent =
    days === 0 ? 'Today!' : days === 1 ? 'day to go' : 'days to go';
  count.style.minWidth = String(days).length + 'ch';  // no jitter while it counts
  countdown.hidden = false;
  if (days === 0) return;
  if (still) { count.textContent = days; return; }
  count.textContent = 0;

  // the countdown runs up while the calendar flips to the event's month
  function countUp(ms) {
    var start = performance.now();
    (function tick(t) {
      var p = Math.min(1, (t - start) / ms);
      count.textContent = Math.round(days * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3)));
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    })(start);
  }

  // the calendar starts on today's page; one page per month is flipped up and
  // away until the event's own page (the one in the HTML) is left
  var cal = root.querySelector('.fe-cal');
  var months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
  var first = today.getFullYear() * 12 + today.getMonth();
  var last = event.getFullYear() * 12 + event.getMonth();
  var leaves = [];
  for (var m = first; m === first || m < last; m++) {
    var leaf = cal.querySelector('.fe-page').cloneNode(true);
    leaf.classList.add('is-leaf');
    leaf.querySelector('.fe-cal-month').textContent = months[m % 12];
    leaf.querySelector('.fe-cal-day').textContent = m === first ? today.getDate() : ' ';
    leaf.querySelector('.fe-cal-year').textContent = Math.floor(m / 12);
    leaves.push(leaf);
  }
  leaves.slice().reverse().forEach(function (leaf) { cal.appendChild(leaf); });  // today's on top

  var per = Math.max(140, Math.min(420, 1500 / leaves.length));
  function flip(i) {
    if (i === leaves.length) { cal.classList.add('is-landed'); return; }
    leaves[i].animate([
      { transform: 'perspective(500px) rotateX(0deg)', opacity: 1 },
      { transform: 'perspective(500px) rotateX(100deg)', opacity: 0.4 }
    ], { duration: per, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.75, 0)', fill: 'forwards' })
      .onfinish = function () { leaves[i].remove(); flip(i + 1); };
  }
  setTimeout(function () {
    countUp(leaves.length * per + 300);
    flip(0);
  }, 900);
})();
</script>
```
